metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace for the dw (Dev Workflow) plugin.

plugins.name: dw
plugins.description: AI-native SDLC workflow for GitHub: issue (or local item) -> design grilling -> approved plan -> test-first -> implement -> simplify -> test -> fresh review -> gated commit, PR and issue writes. Small orchestrator context, heavy work in subagents, rules in hooks, stack-agnostic repo profiles.
